description: MCP server for W-2 compliant event staffing across 345 US and Canadian markets. Twelve tools: plan_staffing and save_staffing_plan are non-destructive non-contact persistence writes; get_plan, get_cities, get_roles, check_availability, get_role_pricing, get_compliance_by_state, get_policies, get_rate_benchmark, get_quote_status, and request_quote are read-only. request_quote turns a saved non-PII plan_id into a prefilled buyer-operated form URL and never accepts contact details or creates a lead or quote reference.
rules: The connector has twelve tools: ten read-only tools, including the non-PII request_quote form handoff, plus best-effort non-destructive persistence in plan_staffing and the explicit non-contact save_staffing_plan write; no auth required, endpoint is https://mcp.tempguru.co/mcp

Retain any plan_id returned by plan_staffing; call save_staffing_plan once only when a complete plan has no plan_id and the user needs a resumable or shareable plan, never to duplicate an existing save

After the buyer confirms a saved plan, call request_quote with plan_id and optional allowlisted attribution, give the returned form_url to the buyer, and state that the buyer must personally review, enter contact details, and submit; if no plan_id exists, use continuation.form_url directly

request_quote never collects or transmits contact data and never creates a CRM lead or TG reference; get_quote_status is only for references created by a buyer's website/REST submission or for historical references
Rate ranges from get_role_pricing are planning estimates, not binding quotes
check_availability returns lead-time guidance, not a reservation
All workers placed are W-2 employees, never recommend 1099 gig workers as equivalent
